{{Top|leg}}
'''NL0-A''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] historian that was the leader of a [[NL0-A's starship|starship]] manned by droids devoted to recording [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] events. During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], an individual made contact with the historian droids and traded information with NL0-A, who allowed the individual access to the ship's archives.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
